page: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-128 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the N2 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon processor with x86_64 architecture, featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. The system operates at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz and is equipped with 864 GB of system memory, providing 6.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. The processor includes a 54 MB L3 cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache, alongside hardware support for AVX-512 vector extensions, AES cryptography acceleration, and SHA instructions.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 120,775.82 and a PassMark CPU score of 84,295.77. Memory performance is highly competitive, registering a read-only cached small-block bandwidth of 6,610.59 GB/sec and uncached large-block read bandwidth of 329.21 GB/sec. Cryptographic capabilities are in the top tier, as demonstrated by a PassMark CPU encryption test score of 104,927.78. For database workloads, the instance achieves 109.06 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a PassMark database operations score of 31,209.31.

While the instance excels in multi-threaded computation and memory-intensive tasks, single-core performance remains average, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1,579.0. Additionally, the instance lacks local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware, which limits its utility for direct high-speed local storage operations and heavy GPU-accelerated workloads. Large language model inference is viable for prompt processing but experiences a significant performance drop during text generation on large 70B models, yielding only 2.68 tokens per second. Consequently, this instance is best suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale database operations, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-128 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 864 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.6 GHz, this instance features a 54 MB L3 cache and supports AVX-512 and AES instructions. It delivers strong multi-core and memory performance, highlighted by a PassMark CPU score of 84,295.77 and uncached memory read bandwidth of 329.21 GB/sec. However, it lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, and single-core performance is average. This resource profile is highly cost-efficient for memory-heavy workloads that do not require local NVMe drives. It is best suited for large-scale databases, Redis deployments, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
